ENC.description: Encryption Header containing all parameters needed for decryption

EPHEMERAL_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Ephemeral public key for ECDH key agreement (32-65 bytes depending on algorithm)

NONCE_START.description: Random 12-byte nonce starting value. Incremented for each record in the stream to ensure unique nonces.

RECIPIENT_KEY_ID.description: Optional identifier for the recipient's public key (up to 32 bytes)

SCHEMA_HASH.description: Optional SHA-256 hash of the FlatBuffers schema (32 bytes)

ROOT_TYPE.description: Optional root type name from the schema

TIMESTAMP.description: Optional Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when encryption was performed

METHOD.description: Request method verb (for example GET, POST). Empty on a response.

ROUTE.description: Request route, path plus optional query. Empty on a response.

BODY_FILE_ID.description:
Four-character file identifier of BODY when BODY is a FlatBuffer,
`$` included (for example "$EPM"). Empty when BODY is not a FlatBuffer.

STATUS.description: Response status code. Zero on a request.

SIGNER_KEY_ID.description: Identifier of the signer's key; MUST identify RPC.SIGNER_PUBLIC_KEY.

REPLY_KEY.description: Request only: public key the response is sealed to.

REQUEST_NONCE.description: Response only: RPC.NONCE of the request being answered.

REQUEST_DIGEST.description:
Response only: SHA-256 (32 bytes) of the complete size-prefixed request
RPC FlatBuffer as received, signatures included.

RPC.description: Sealed Remote Procedure Call envelope (outer, plaintext, signed).

VERSION.description: Envelope version. This document defines version 1.

ENCRYPTION.description:
Encryption header for CIPHERTEXT. CONTEXT is "RPC/1|request" or
"RPC/1|response" matching DIRECTION.

SESSION_ID.description: Optional session identifier established by a prior sign-in.

SENDER_KEY_ID.description:
Optional identifier of the sender's key (routing hint only; the binding
identity is SIGNER_PUBLIC_KEY checked against RPCBody.SIGNER_KEY_ID).

TIMESTAMP.description: Sender clock at signing, milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

SIGNER_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Ed25519 public key (32 bytes) that verifies both signatures.

SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over the size-prefixed FlatBuffer with both 64-byte
signature payloads zeroed while preserving their vectors and offsets.

CANONICAL_JSON_SIGNATURE.description:
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON with IDL field order and
capitalization, no insignificant whitespace, and both signature fields
omitted.
